name: obc-dance-card
description: Electronic dance card for Orewa Bridge Club

scripts.test: npm run build -w @obc/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @obc/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.emulators: npm run bundle -w @obc/functions && firebase --config firebase/firebase.json --project demo-obc emulators:start
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:rules && npm run deploy:functions && npm run deploy:hosting
